semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in gallium oxide materials and equipment solutions for ultra-wide bandgap semiconductors.
summary: Hangzhou GAREN Semiconductor Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of gallium oxide (GaO) materials and equipment, focusing on the development and industrialization of ultra-wide bandgap semiconductors. Their product offerings include GaO single crystals, substrates, and crystal growth equipment, aimed at delivering comprehensive solutions to global customers.
capabilities: 2-8 inch GaO single crystals and substrates
GaO vertical Bridgman crystal growth equipment

regional_presence.China: The company is recognized as a National-level Science and Technology-based SME and has received multiple provincial awards for innovation and contributions to the semiconductor industry.
